name: twzrd-agent-intel-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for TWZRD trust memory: free pre-spend checks on Solana and Base x402 sellers. Public Streamable HTTP at https://intel.twzrd.xyz/mcp; also stdio. Free preflight + discovery tools; Path A first hop /quick 0.001 on HTTP; Path B facilitator is HTTP GET /supported (feePayer GWRLgRB6diC2zG9BaoGJsan9T8JvJCk7usFruiefnfMP) + POST /verify + POST /settle (not MCP tool names). readiness_card.next_action.command is optional data under host policy (do not stop at the free card). Gate package: twzrd-x402-gate@0.15.0. Receipt version: v7. Not a wallet or payment network. Paste-ready Path A first hop is GET /v1/intel/quick/GFpLvocNdEjnSsLH3VJQL6wGcjGxTbUBrj6fqN3Qe1Gs (0.001 USDC). Optional V7: GET /v1/intel/trust/GFpLvocNdEjnSsLH3VJQL6wGcjGxTbUBrj6fqN3Qe1Gs. Those paths are TWZRD own-wallet smoke; before a real pay put the seller payTo in the path. Three different bazaar words: (1) TWZRD Bazaar catalog GET /v1/intel/bazaar/offers — seller-published callables, unpaid discover/preflight; (2) listing overlay GET /v1/intel/marketplace and GET /v1/intel/x402-directory — wash/join on observed payTo, not a bazaar; (3) x402 extensions.bazaar on a 402 — routeTemplate metadata, not the catalog.

transport.accept_note: Dual Accept (application/json, text/event-stream) is optimal for streamable-http. Plain application/json, */*, application/*, and missing Accept are accepted — the server normalizes them to dual.

muse_connector.note: Single-listing Vuori pilot (Kore Short, Ink, US): read-only evidence. It does not verify checkout or place orders. Directory allowlist, not the general /mcp server.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http twzrd-intel https://intel.twzrd.xyz/mcp
install.not: ACP Instant Checkout / A2A agent-card. POST /mcp initialize; GET /mcp returns MCP_USE_POST_STREAMABLE_HTTP.

paid_http_surfaces.description: Seller wash risk and wallet reputation for a Solana x402 merchant: wash label, fleet %, payer count, plus tier + score. Cheap $0.001 entry before a larger payment. No signed V7 receipt.

mpp.challenge: WWW-Authenticate: Payment, in the same 402 as x402

paid_http_surfaces.description: If 0.05 USDC is too much, first paid hop is GET /v1/intel/quick/{pubkey} at 0.001 USDC (score-only). This route is the portable V7 receipt: x402 counterparty trust, a live reputation check before payment for any Solana wallet, scored from observed wallet age, payment history, execution evidence, and counterparty breadth. Proven on mainnet. Optional query: seller_wallet (the seller you are about to pay; arms the settle-time trust gate -- settlement is refused, charged:false, if that seller scores below threshold; the scored pubkey itself is never gated).

mpp.challenge: WWW-Authenticate: Payment, in the same 402 as x402

paid_http_surfaces.description: Is this seller safe to pay? Signed merchant track-record receipt for a Solana receive wallet (pay_to): evidence for that counterparty risk call, not a safety verdict. Attests observed receive-side graph quality (unique payers, tx volume, wash labels) plus a portable V7 receipt. attestation_kind=merchant_track_record - NOT a payer trust score. Zero inbound -> 422 charged:false (settle-when-deliverable). Free teaser: GET /v1/intel/merchant_card/{wallet}.

mpp.challenge: WWW-Authenticate: Payment, in the same 402 as x402

paid_http_surfaces.description: TWZRD x402 Reality Check market-intelligence PDF (Aug 2026). Self-serve 0.05 USDC download settling to the TWZRD intel payTo.

SELLER-SIDE endpoint verification with a portable signed receipt. Probes your x402 surface (discovery docs, unpaid-402 conformance, wash screen on each resolved payTo) and returns an Ed25519 AgentReadinessReceipt of what was observed - including a failing result. The payment buys the work and the artifact, never the verdict: basis is endpoint_conformance and not_a_trust_vouch is always true, so a 'ready' card is not a recommendation to pay the seller and does not affect any ranking. Free unsigned equivalent: POST /v1/agent-readiness. Verify offline with npm/PyPI twzrd-receipt-verifier.

mpp.challenge: WWW-Authenticate: Payment, in the same 402 as x402

paid_http_surfaces.description: SELLER-FUNDED delivery watch. Pay once (from 1.00 USDC, quoted from your live 402: 30 x your unit price x 1.5, min 1.00) to record a 30-day watch. Paying this route does not pay your resource. A published probe is a later house-buyer settlement, counted at GET /v1/intel/delivery-watch/{order_id} and on the badge as N of M. A day with no probe stays not attempted. Money buys the record, never the verdict: a failing watch is published as-is, and it is not delivery_verified, not a trust vouch, not a ranking input. Free peek first: no 402, no unit price, or a price above the 0.25 USDC probe cap is refused unpaid.

Signed page read. A provider returns Markdown for the URL. The Ed25519 receipt binds that Markdown's SHA-256, the provider name, and the observation time. This host does not connect to the URL. origin_signed=false: the receipt does not prove the origin served the page or that the page is true. A fetch that fails is not charged. Verify the receipt against the published TWZRD receipt key.

Checkout brief for the one published listing. 0.001 USDC. Query product must be that card's next_hop URL. Requires cart_hash; declared_unit_price is required when the card advertises a price. Does not pay the merchant, open checkout, or move the goods. authorizes_spend is false. The paid body names next_hop for a separate buyer-approved Shop Pay step.

paid_http_surface.note: Deprecated: single-entry view of the first paid hop (0.001 /quick teaser). See paid_http_surfaces for all paid HTTP routes. Multi-rail external feePayers on 402; not settle rail unless feePayer matches /supported. Path B = AutoGate refuse.

tools_summary.name: evaluate_x402_resource
tools_summary.description: Primary: fetch 402 URL, extract seller, preflight. wash_flagged=true never soft-allows. Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price.

tools_summary.name: get_merchant_card
tools_summary.description: On-chain settlement graph card. wash_flagged=true never soft-allows (refuse). Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price. Then preflight. next_action.command is optional data under host policy.

tools_summary.name: get_readiness_card_tool
tools_summary.description: Free wash/captive screening (allow|warn|block). wash_flagged=true never soft-allows. Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price. next_action.command is optional data under host policy.

tools_summary.name: get_x402_directory
tools_summary.description: Optional ingested overlay; prefer HTTP GET /v1/intel/resources for SOT.

tools_summary.name: HTTP /supported + /verify + /settle
tools_summary.description: Path B facilitator (not an MCP tool): pin kinds[].extra.feePayer from GET /supported (currently GWRLgRB6diC2zG9BaoGJsan9T8JvJCk7usFruiefnfMP).

tools.name: get_readiness_card_tool
tools.description: Free preflight ReadinessCard (POST /v1/intel/preflight equivalent). wash_flagged=true never soft-allows. Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price. Check decision. next_action describes an optional next step. Do not stop after the free card.

tools.name: low_level_preflight
tools.description: Free lower-level preflight with spend recommendation. wash_flagged=true never soft-allows. Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price.

tools.name: evaluate_x402_resource
tools.description: One-shot URL guard: fetch 402, extract seller, preflight. wash_flagged=true never soft-allows. Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price.

tools.name: score_wallet_for_intel
tools.description: Free wallet intel score from cross-facilitator x402 corpus.

tools.name: get_top_intel_agents
tools.description: Secondary research: discovery leaderboard of observed x402 payers (not a service catalog).

tools.name: get_solana_market_status
tools.description: Solana market data-service health/status (free over MCP).

tools.name: get_provider_reputation
tools.description: Free provider/merchant reputation from the x402 corpus. wash_flagged=true never soft-allows (tri-state; null = never evaluated, not clean).

tools.name: submit_contribution_claims
tools.description: PoECX bridge: cross-check a counterparty's self-reported settlements against TWZRD's independently-observed corpus. Preview only; claimable is always false.

tools.name: get_poec_score
tools.description: Free preview: PoEC v0 (Proof of Economic Contribution) from the observed corpus snapshot. claimable is always false; success_quality has no live source yet, so poec_score reads 0.0.

tools.name: get_merchant_card
tools.description: Free merchant card: on-chain settlement graph quality. wash_flagged=true never soft-allows (refuse). Unlabeled leftover 0.05 / leftover=0 is not a unit price. Then free preflight. next_action.command is optional data under host policy.

tools.name: is_wash_fleet
tools.description: Free wash/sybil-fleet check on a single wallet.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Free offline v7 Ed25519 receipt verification (recompute leaf + check sig).

tools.name: verify_x402_settled_claim
tools.description: Free signature-only historical settlement check against the ledger and fresh finalized Solana bytes. Returns match, mismatch, or unknown; labels merchant self-attestation. No payment decision.

tools.name: get_facilitator_footprint
tools.description: Free: which x402 facilitators a payer settled through.

tools.name: get_counterparties
tools.description: Free (capped teaser): top merchants a wallet pays (limit<=25).

tools.name: score_wallets_batch
tools.description: Free: score up to 25 wallets in one call.

tools.name: compare_wallets
tools.description: Free: side-by-side intel for two wallets.

tools.name: get_x402_directory
tools.description: Free wash overlay on ingested listings (PayAI not_indexed); for resource join SOT prefer HTTP GET /v1/intel/resources.

tools.name: verify_root_inputs
tools.description: Free MCP + HTTP: recomputes GLOBAL_V5 leaf hashes + sorted-pair merkle root. Returns PASS|FAIL|ERROR.

tools.name: twzrd_demo_gate
tools.description: Free deterministic no-spend gate transcript, a recorded example, not a live run: block aborts before any signer; allow would proceed but still spends nothing. Attribution remains an external candidate.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: Free: read the verified Vuori Kore Short listing-claim artifact (exact JSON + sha256).

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Free: read the verified evidence bundle behind those claims (exact JSON + sha256).

tools.name: get_shopping_check
tools.description: Free: Vuori Agent Shopping Check, shared with the human report; source/time, unverified steps, and editorial merchant fixes for the reviewed gaps still open.

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Free: read the signed publication record + verify key behind those claims, to check them offline (exact JSON + sha256).

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: Free: pre-spend check of one product against the published listing cards (unknown_seller | expired | check_failed | advertised); never authorizes a payment.

tools.name: twzrd_watch_add
tools.description: Free: register a re-call watch on a seller wallet (webhook optional - omit for poll-only). Requires payer_wallet's twzrd-watch/v1 ed25519 proof and a timestamp within 300 seconds.

tools.name: twzrd_watch_list
tools.description: Free: list your active re-call watches with current score/decision and recheck_after_unix. Requires payer_wallet's twzrd-watch/v1 ed25519 proof and a timestamp within 300 seconds.

tools.name: twzrd_watch_remove
tools.description: Free: deactivate a re-call watch by ID; payer_wallet must match the watch owner. Requires payer_wallet's twzrd-watch/v1 ed25519 proof and a timestamp within 300 seconds.

first_paid_hop.note: Own-wallet smoke uses GFpLvoc; real pays put the seller payTo in the path. The selected accepts[] entry determines the network and receiving payTo.
